Note

Do not use the browser's back and refresh buttons. You will lose your information using the browser buttons. Information in ART is only stored locally on your computer, and the US Government does not have access to the information you place into the tool. If you wish to keep your work, please save the data locally for future use by using the 'Save (.json)' button. You can reload a previously saved form using the 'Continue, View/Export' button from the previous landing page.
